purpose: Published full-size Flash-Next is the quality reference. Local Q4 is a diagnostic comparison, not the oracle.
owner_priorities: General agentic help, tool use, vision, general knowledge and practical thinking
pure_math: Published-reference sanity check; low weight in local tuning and deployment selection
local_full_precision_inference: Forbidden by owner; no Q8/full-size reference target loading

published_paired_reference.precision_scope: GSQ includes its fixed IQ4_NL ngram table; original BF16 table is a separate recovery experiment
published_paired_reference.interpretation: Paired published quantization evidence; does not certify the local runtime or prove every task is preserved

official_full_size_reference.interpretation: Task/harness-specific published scores; keep distinct from DASLab's paired evaluation and local bounded screens

requirements: Expand paired practical/code and knowledge screens
Pass exact tool/JSON and vision canaries
Verify runtime/template/representation differences before attributing failures to quantization
local_gate_status.principle: Do not convert token agreement or a benchmark recovery ratio into a universal retained-intelligence percentage
